name: projected
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove: the remaining displacement << 10 while it is projected off the contact planes (dword stores at 0x50eebe/0x50eecd/0x50eedd)

name: normalSum
meaning: sum of the normals projected off in one pass; 3/8 of their mean is added back (dword zeroing at 0x50ef2f/0x50ef3c)

name: step
meaning: the part of the displacement travelled up to the first contact (word store at 0x50e958); reused as box corner minus contact point (0x50eb26/0x50eb39)

name: contactClass
meaning: per contact of the last sweep: 1 floor, 2 wall, 4 floor-plane contact the box corner is below (byte stores at 0x50ec7f/0x50ec91/0x50ed08)
